text:
Rina Gupta: FYI — Alex Monroe (SWE Staff candidate) confirmed hybrid loop for Tue May 21. Candidate flying in, wants a quiet room between interviews and has a severe peanut allergy. Can we lock logistics?
Alejandra Rivera: Noted. Do we have arrival time + airport transfer?
Rina Gupta: Arrival 09:05 local, taxi booked. Interviewers start at 11:00. Prefers quiet room from 10:30–13:30.
Matt O'Neill: I can shift my panel to 11:15 to give them buffer.
Priya Shah: 11:15 works for me. Also can do async feedback if needed.
Alejandra Rivera: Great — tagging Facilities. Need a small quiet room (no open seating), whiteboard, meeting phone, and a Mac loaner with charger.
Facilities: We can reserve Quiet Room B (2nd floor) and badge guest access. Any dietary prefs for end-of-loop lunch?
Rina Gupta: Severe peanut allergy — no nuts or traces. Prefers vegan if options help.
Facilities: Got it. We'll mark catering "peanut-free" and vegan option available. Badge will be ready at 09:00.
Alejandra Rivera: Matt — can you confirm you'll join in-person? Need at least two in-person interviewers.
Matt O'Neill: I'll be on-site. Priya remote. One more in-person needed — assigning to Ben (recruiter pinged separately).
Priya Shah: I'll send meeting link and add my feedback doc to the calendar event.
Rina Gupta: Also need travel stipend processed and expense pre-authorization for taxi and dinner.
PeopleOps Bot: Expense pre-auth created: code HR-TRAVEL-2026. Please attach receipts to the ticket after the visit.
Alejandra Rivera: Quick schedule I pasted to calendar invite (small table):
```
10:30–11:00 — Quiet room arrival / check-in
11:15–12:00 — Technical panel (Matt + Ben)
12:00–12:30 — Takeaway / quiet prep
12:30–13:00 — Lunch (peanut-free)
13:00–13:30 — Wrap + hiring manager chat (Matt)
```
Alejandra Rivera: Facilities — can you confirm A/V + Mac loaner pickup location?
Facilities: AV check scheduled for 09:30. Mac loaner pickup at Concierge desk. We'll put a sticky note with candidate name.
Rina Gupta: Perfect. I'll send candidate confirmation and the arrival badge instructions.
Matt O'Neill: Thanks all. If anything changes ping me here. :thumbsup:
Alejandra Rivera: I'll update the calendar and add a short checklist for the onsite host.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar invite updated and sent to participants.
Rina Gupta: Closing the loop — thanks!
